title: knowing others experience this is freaking me out - my mall world tour

locations.location_name: childhood street (cardboard cutout version) in a valley

position.relative_to: in the middle of an unfamiliar valley; meets a T-intersection with roads east/west

qualities.raw_description: “strange, deserted cardboard cutout of my old childhood street”; buildings shift from “elaborate and pristine” to “oddly geometric… 2D ‘cardboard cutouts’ to totally empty”; “heavily-compressed PS2 fakeout zone”

locations.location_name: empty food takeout joint

position.relative_to: if you walk east on the road, on the left side

qualities.raw_description: “unfinished like a PS2 model of a restaurant”; “Dark brown wooden floors, grey countertops and walls, brick foundation, neon signs”; “large windows make everything bright”

locations.location_name: shopping plaza with black-window rooms

position.relative_to: on the right side of the road across from the takeout joint

qualities.raw_description: “shopping plaza with no signs on any of the buildings”; “windows that lead to pitch black rooms”; “buildings are plain tan”; “parking lot pavement is weathered light grey”; dreamer: “I haven't been able to get over there yet… feels like… I should never go there”

locations.location_name: huge movie theater (with attached ride)

position.relative_to: continuing east on the left side of the road

qualities.raw_description: “ceiling goes up incredibly far”; “entryway is expansive”; “very dark, with only the lighting of the concession stands… to really illuminate”; “glowing movie posters on the walls”; “white tile” floors and “plain white” walls; “completely 100% empty and silent”; “I don't like going there”

locations.location_name: theater showing room

position.relative_to: from theater entrance, down small flight of stairs to carpeted area; left hallway leads to showing room

qualities.raw_description: “red seats sat at an incline”; “massive movie screen playing ads that make the whole room wash out in white”; “so damn dark… I avoided that room”

locations.location_name: theater ride area

position.relative_to: right hallway from the carpeted area inside the theater

qualities.raw_description: “little round cart… green… sits on tracks”; “black tunnel full of black lights”; “small world-esc setups… various fakeout movies”; “goes in a big circle”

locations.location_name: main mall (tan arch entrance embedded in cliff)

position.relative_to: end of the valley; embedded into a cliff; reached by continuing east past the theater

qualities.raw_description: Entrance: “giant tan arch with windows… doors”; inside: “glass domes… faint blue skylight… but the lights are off”; “ceilings… skyrocket upwards”; “empty and quiet”; “L-shape” layout; “white tiles” floor; “grey carpet on the second floor”; “second floor accessible with escalators”; “cut-out balcony… white railings”

locations.location_name: cafe/gift shop combo (inside mall entrance, left)

position.relative_to: immediately to your left after entering the mall; you have to take a step down to get into the room

qualities.raw_description: “red carpet and rows of tan-brown shelves and white walls”

locations.location_name: punk trinket shop (Spencer's-like) at crook of L

position.relative_to: second floor; continuing right from spiral-stair door area; near the crook of the L-shaped layout; step down to enter

qualities.raw_description: “dark… with black carpet and neon blue signs glowing on the walls”; “lava lamps, rubix cubes, novelty office supplies”; “rather small”; “feels disturbing”; “paranoia amps up”

locations.location_name: weird grey library (inside mall)

position.relative_to: from the crook of the L, straight ahead through a wide rectangular entrance

qualities.raw_description: “endless grey metal shelves, off-white walls, fluorescent lights, worn grey carpet, and dry book dust smell”; described as “maze” and “insanely vast expanse”

locations.location_name: other dream malls (reachable via exits in the grey library)

position.relative_to: exits within the grey library marked by white square pillars

qualities.raw_description: “Huge, towering buildings… packed with very realistic people”; “bright and lively”; “smell like cheap Chinese food… Orange chicken”

locations.location_name: ornate wood fantasy-like library (downstairs from grey library)

position.relative_to: downstairs via escalator with glass panel railings within the grey library

qualities.raw_description: “astute, detailed, rather beautiful building decorated with ornate wood”; “bright… with sunlight”; “plush benches in an octagonal lobby”; “crest on the wall made of brushed gold”; “thick… leatherbound… gold inlays” books; visited “once at night to do homework”

locations.location_name: ornate library - bottom floor kids area/reading nook

position.relative_to: bottom floor of the ornate library

qualities.raw_description: “beautifully cozy reading nook and a kid's play area”; “fake green grass carpet”; “tree house play set”; “enchanted forest mural”; “stars that glow in a simulated night sky”

locations.location_name: knick knack shop (left of library exit back into dark mall)

position.relative_to: after exiting the grey library back into the specific dark mall: on the left

qualities.raw_description: “tan wooden walls”; “Disney sponsored gift shop vibes”; “cheapy fandom-themed goods”; “yellowy dim lighting”

locations.location_name: toy shop (right of library exit back into dark mall)

position.relative_to: after exiting the grey library back into the specific dark mall: on the right

qualities.raw_description: “pale white walls and blueish fluorescent lighting”; “meant for very young children”; “Imagine a Babies R' Us”

locations.location_name: candy store (unvisited, second floor)

position.relative_to: in this mall; on the second floor; dreamer hasn't been there

qualities.raw_description: mentioned as a store on the second floor the dreamer “haven't been to”

locations.location_name: mall roof / exit point via spiral staircase

position.relative_to: up the yellow spiral staircase accessed through a blue metal door on the mall's second floor

qualities.raw_description: “bright blue sky and white fluffy clouds”

locations.location_name: large city with grey skyscrapers (seen after roof/spiral stair route)

position.relative_to: reached/seen after going up the spiral staircase to the roof; “out on the horizon”

qualities.raw_description: “large city with grey skyscrapers out on the horizon”

locations.location_name: western road (Windows XP hills emptiness)

position.relative_to: from the mall, down the cliff hill on a winding road; then walking west on the main road away from the T

qualities.raw_description: “There is literally nothing out here on the western road. It's all Windows XP background hills.”

locations.location_name: lonesome blue carpet store (end of west road)

position.relative_to: at the very end of the western road; “scene suddenly turns to night time”

qualities.raw_description: “single light bulb illuminating… over the abandoned check-out desk”; “very pitch black hallways” left and right against back wall; “hangers full of thick square carpet swatches”; “Blue carpet, blue walls, and a brown-grey desk”; “very creepy”

locations.location_name: dreamer’s own childhood home (interior is grey fog / empty jpeg spaces)

position.relative_to: at/along the childhood road section of the T; “The only house I can go in is my own home”

qualities.raw_description: “literally nothing but grey fog and completely empty, jpeg-esc spaces”; “I can walk the layout of my home, but there is nothing here”

locations.location_name: theme park / Disney World - Worlds of Fun - water park - cruise ship - boardwalk mashup vacation dream area

position.relative_to: described as adjacent areas of this mall world; separate visit “just tonight… fifth visit”

qualities.raw_description: “my own Disney World - Worlds of Fun - water park - cruise ship - boardwalk mashup vacation dream”

boundaries.description: Shopping plaza windows “lead to pitch black rooms”; dreamer “hasn't been able to get over there yet” and avoids it.
Spiral staircase route feels like “leaving the mall world… takes me to a large city.”
Inside carpet store: “very pitch black hallways” to left and right; dreamer does not go down them.
Dreamer has “no recollection of exploring the bottom of the mall”; “It's too dark and my gut tells me there's just nothing down there.”

interactions.description: Sat inside the takeout joint and looked out the large windows at the rest of the street trying to understand what was happening.
Avoided entering the showing room after peeking in because it was extremely dark.
Rode the green cart ride through a blacklight tunnel with small display setups; notes popcorn tastes stale and old.

entities_involved.description: skinny ginger guy with short curly hair; “pops in and out of being a PS2 model”; doesn’t talk; comes off as dorky

interactions.description: Helped the cafe/gift shop worker scrub the carpets.

entities_involved.description: latina woman; talkative; speech sounds like “twenty different things at once” with overlapping voice

interactions.description: Took escalator from mall entrance area to the second floor.
Encountered a cashier-like NPC at the trinket shop register; could not make out what she was saying due to muffled sound.

entities_involved.description: woman with an afro; “PS2 NPC replica” running the cash register; speech muffled

interactions.transaction_blocker: could not understand speech / communication unclear

interactions.description: Navigated the vast grey library maze; noted exits with white square pillars leading to other dream malls; once entered another mall and became incredibly lost.
Came once at night to do homework in the ornate library; notes realistic people present (children, adults in business casual, bookkeepers who seem mirage-like).

entities_involved.description: realistic people; children; adults in business casual uniforms talking; bookkeepers “fleeting… like a mirage”

interactions.description: Entered the carpet store; observed abandoned checkout desk, carpet samples, and two pitch-black hallways; avoided the hallways.

extraction.extraction_notes: Post contains a primary recurring valley/T-intersection map with east/west routes plus a detailed interior mall (L-shaped, 2 floors) and nested library spaces. Several additional adjacent dream areas (theme-park/waterpark/cruise/boardwalk mashup, hotels) are mentioned only briefly and not spatially specified beyond being ‘adjacent’/separate visits.
